\paragraph{Faster rows.}
Pre-repair run 21070 bucketed rows faster than monolithic: 21/735. These rows are negative diagnostic evidence from the pre-repair executor, not paper-scale speedup evidence.

\paragraph{Mechanism versus scheduler.}
Executed lane-steps are hardware independent and separate the executor from the scheduler. The deployed scheduler reached an executed-work ratio of 0.607, while oracle plans on the same realized depths reach 0.380 through the same executor.
Planning accounted for 3.9\% of warm time.
The oracle\_current wall speedup of 1.762x is an analysis-only upper bound and cannot satisfy the wall-clock gate.
